mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 56 degree temperatures under partly cloudy skies near City Hall, with a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead, an overnight low of 49 degrees, and rain in the forecast.

The city has announced that buildings will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, with trash pickup delayed until Friday. Also, the Public Works department is planning an expansion to better serve our growing population.
It is a busy couple of days for local entertainment. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, the music continues at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the records from November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash where a driver was arrested for O W I with a child in the vehicle.
The flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open but will be closing soon at 10:30 PM, so make sure to get your treat while you can.
